notes: scan055.N1: The page defines dotted X_i and X_i^* in (26), states that the starred pieces are disjoint and cover X, identifies the piece containing x by i(x), and lifts the construction to Delta_r in (27)–(28). These statements were carried as background while reading; this first-reader report does not claim a proof. The later main-reader checks are recorded in scan055.N13 and scan055.N14.

scan055.N2: The NB's first object is literally unstarred X_i. Its conjunction with the later X_i ne phi is awkward on its face, but the missing star is not restored. The quoted phrase il n'y a pas d'inconvénient, barred m, uncertain sous-ensemble short form, and uncertain contracted adverb are preserved as written.

scan055.N3: The proof literally writes x in X_i setminus X_k after already obtaining x in X_k. No overdot is visible on this X_i and the relation is a single diagonal. The expected mathematical repair was used only to identify the risk of normalization, not to change the source. The earlier X_j^* subset X_j setminus X_i^* and the missing sont are also kept.

scan055.N4: The lower target in (28) is written X_{X_0}^*, with a crossed X inside the subscript. Its expected Delta_0 counterpart is not substituted. Both map labels show sigma_r; the final map has its full colon, domain, arrow and codomain.

scan055.N5: The NB tail has four separately inventoried local layers: a short deleted sa|ca fragment, deleted d'ailleurs, raised live satisfont, and a separate lower deleted satisfont. These are spatial layers; no unsupported chronology beyond cancellation/replacement is asserted. All partially obscured readings remain doubtful. The proof's alors, (car), interlinear cancelled trial (now the doubtful x in Xi cap Xj = span; see scan055.N15) and the later par are separately checked.

scan055.N6: The three empty-set signs are oval forms crossed by descending stems and are transcribed as phi at each occurrence. Definition labels in (26) differ locally: first déf, second def, both above equality. The NB's bar-m and possible clairem with raised t are not silently expanded.

scan055.N7: Formula (26) is side by side with lower unparenthesized glosses. Formula (27) has a two-row left brace and a surviving final comma. The brace of (28) stops at the starred-object row; the final par-map lies below its end. Both (28) glosses lack parentheses. The closed-gloss index remains constrained by the original page edge.

scan055.N8: Punctuation was read locally. There is no point after Proposition or the NB's final d); no supplied proof stops/commas after the places listed in changes; there is an actual stop after Dém., an actual comma after (27), and final points in (26) and (28). A small fleck before x after donc on the Or line has no diagnostic comma tail and is left as residue.

scan055.N9: Four supplied marks remain undecided: M0991, M0993, M0994 and M0998. The first two have changed tentative preferred readings rather than secure resolutions. The other unresolved cancelled words/formula and the newly recovered short fragment are explicitly listed in doubts. No H editorial note is treated as manuscript text.

scan055.N10. First-pass accounting, retained as history; the final reconciled totals are in the changes summary and this report’s counts object. Counting uses physical change rows with diff flags, including tentative disagreements; it excludes pure macro/provenance and certainty-only differences. There are 83 substantive rows: C 15 (12 secure, 3 tentative), H 78 (69 secure, 9 tentative); 10 rows affect both, 5 C only and 68 H only. Union: 74 secure and 9 tentative. Of 13 supplied marks, 6 select the first reading, 3 the alternative and 4 remain undecided. There are 19 distinct crops/audit boxes and 24 inventory elements. Each repeated glyph, quote endpoint and local cancellation has its own physical row or inventory element.

scan055.N11: Whole-page layout and the two supplied native halves were read once each, including every agreed word. Nineteen distinct crops were then inspected. The r02 lower edge was extended while its gloss was still open; final boundary repairs to r02 at x=245 and r12 at y=1705 include the complete formula parenthesis and upper overdot. These boundary repairs were checked once without changing the readings and were accepted by root. Diagonal NB crops r03/r04/r16/r17/r18/r19 are rotated clockwise 35 degrees only for viewing; all boxes retain original source coordinates. No OCR, research, other-page image/report, or TeX compilation was used.

scan055.N12: The top dark 15 belongs to the author's numbering; the pale bottom-left 54 is another hand's foliation. The latter is encoded as a margin element. Its wrapper change is not counted as a C textual correction, while both written numerals omitted by H are counted as omissions.

scan055.N13: Targeted proof of the proposition. For x in X let m=i(x), the least containing index supplied by scan054. Membership x in X_i^* forces m=i: otherwise m<i puts x in the lower union. Conversely no index below m contains x, so x lies in X_m^*. Therefore x belongs to exactly one starred piece, proving disjointness and covering. The two literal proof slips described in N3 remain in the transcription.

scan055.N14: Targeted proof of the NB reduction. Let I' be the indices with nonempty starred piece. Each point's least containing index belongs to I', so the retained pieces cover X. Closedness, local finiteness and inclusion compatibility pass to the subfamily. If x lies in retained X_i and X_j, its retained least index m is at most both, proving the common-lower-piece condition. For retained i, any x in a removed lower X_j has retained m≤j<i, so the lower union is unchanged and hence so is X_i^*. See audit/151_scan055_root_mathematics.md for the full check.

scan055.N15. Blind adjudication recovers the cancelled interlinear trial as x in Xi cap Xj =, still unsure under the strike, replacing the first proposed inequality sentence. It prefers singular disjoint with a plural alternative, and records the two tiny equality-adjacent points in (27) as a doubtful colon in the written order =:. The dense NB keeps its distinct four revision layers, literal short forms and separate main-text neighbors. Neither the two live proof slips nor the sigma notation nor the literal lower X_{X_0}-star is repaired.
